verdict.rationale: Reflect's own marketing claims end-to-end encryption 'no one else can read them (not even us)' and syncs notes across devices, but a documented founder statement clarifies files/images uploaded to notes are NOT end-to-end encrypted, directly contradicting the blanket claim for a meaningful class of content. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the sync architecture/protocol, independent security audit details, and confirmation that all content types (not just text) are covered by E2EE.
